reasoning: The icon depicts a standard mountain-landscape picture glyph flanked by two vertical bars representing stacked slides or a carousel/gallery view. It fits tasks about photo albums, slideshows, image galleries, and UI carousels, though at small sizes the two bars can easily be misread as a 'pause' symbol next to an image.
